name: Can a general contractor handle both storm damage restoration and aesthetic repairs?

mainEntity.name: Can a general contractor handle both storm damage restoration and aesthetic repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, reputable general contractors handle structural and finish repairs caused by storms, water leaks, or interior wear, alongside full remodels. When addressing storm or water damage, the contractor assesses the affected framing, drywall, and subflooring to ensure damp or rotted materials are completely removed before rebuilding. They reconstruct damaged framing, install and blend new drywall, patch or lay new tile, and paint surfaces to match the surrounding rooms seamlessly. Working with a contractor skilled in full renovations ensures that repair work blends cleanly into existing architecture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a general contractor can strip damaged materials, repair framing and drywall, address structural issues, and apply matching finish work like paint and tile.
